motivation: v3 utility gate failed; follow the predeclared capability-requirement branch
inner_ensemble: five train-only KFold fits; validation predictions are averaged
fold_baseline: best single model by outer-train mean utility only
capability_estimator: multi-output Ridge(alpha=10) from standardized six-dimensional requirements to utility
capability_definition: the six train-fold Ridge coefficients for each model
advantage: predicted candidate utility minus predicted fold-local baseline utility
selection_rule: switch only when the maximum one-sided 90% inner-ensemble advantage LCB is above zero
pass_action: freeze method and prepare a new outcome-blind v4 holdout before collecting outcomes
fail_action: stop adding router complexity and report the routability-learnability gap
